commits.messageBody:
The plan-quality judge flagged that M2 framed cross-stack as a
dashboard while the new Done-when frames it as a gate, with no Plan
item wiring the gate. Reframe M2 to the cross-stack publish gate
(lib-substrate.sh + cross-stack-gate.sh + 20- entry + test harness),
move the coverage dashboard to a deferred M4, add a top-level Done
when, and bump estimate 1.0 -> 6.0h (M1+M3 already shipped ~140 LOC).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: #4: reconcile plan for cross-stack gate (Phase D) + refresh estimate

commits.messageBody:
Elevate the cross-stack check from a coverage tracker to a hard
publish gate: a *passed* substrate file must have reviewed-by =/=
generated-by, else same-stack review degrades to mere fresh-context
and the \"two stacks agree\" guarantee is hollow.

- lib-substrate.sh: factor substrate discovery + fail-closed
  frontmatter parse out of review-gate.sh (DRY; both gates share it).
  review-gate.sh refactored to consume it, behavior-preserving.
- cross-stack-gate.sh: per passed substrate file in range, block on
  same-stack or missing/duplicate stack fields (exact inequality;
  compound-stack overlap deferred to M4). Not-yet-passed files are
  review-gate.sh domain, skipped here -- the two gates stay orthogonal.
- merge-checks.d/20-cross-stack-gate.sh: wrapper; runner picks it up
  by 20- ordering after 10-review-gate.
- tests/test-gates.sh: 13-assert harness over a throwaway git fixture
  + an end-to-end run-merge-checks pass. Closes the no-committed-test
  gap the plan-quality judge flagged.
- review.md: publish standard is now the two-assertion form.

Verified: harness 13/13; real-data review-gate still flags
john-pimentel (behavior-preserving); cross-stack over all substrate
-> exit 0 (all claude/codex); runner executes both entries.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: #4 M2: cross-stack publish gate (ariadne #53 Phase D)

commits.messageBody:
Review verdict was SHIP/no-Critical; folded in the two findings worth
fixing pre-merge plus the recommended test cases:

- Unclosed frontmatter fence was the one fail-PERMISSIVE path (body
  read as metadata). awk now buffers the interior and emits it only
  when a closing --- is seen; no fence => no frontmatter => fields
  <missing> => block.
- Tolerate CRLF (strip trailing \r) so a legit CRLF file parses
  instead of false-blocking; still fails closed if malformed.
- test-gates.sh: add body-only-review, duplicate-key, empty-file,
  and unclosed-fence cases (now 20/20). These pin the exact
  Codex-class failure modes the gate exists to defend.

Real-data re-verified: cross-stack over all substrate -> 0;
review-gate still flags john-pimentel. Lesson logged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: #4 M2: address fresh-eyes review on the gate (fail-closed hardening)

commits.messageBody:
you-decide PR #4 merge-check fired but failed (exit 127): the
run-merge-checks.sh runner is a sibling symlink into ../ariadne,
which the GitHub Actions checkout (you-decide only) does not have.
Gate logic is correct + proven; the #52 CI delivery mechanism is
the bug. Pending base-layer fix decision (checkout ariadne vs
vendor the runner).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: #4 M2: log Phase E finding — symlinked CI runner absent in Actions

commits.messageBody:
…olves

Phase E fix: the merge-check workflow failed (exit 127) because
scripts/run-merge-checks.sh is a sibling symlink into ../ariadne,
absent in the isolated GitHub Actions checkout. Add a step that runs
BOOTSTRAP_CLONE_ONLY=1 ./bootstrap.sh before the checks — the same
single-script mechanism any ariadne-style repo uses to clone its
upstream peer chain as siblings; CLONE_ONLY skips the heavy make
bootstrap handoff. Peer URLs derive from origin (public ariadne, no
token). Guarded on bootstrap.sh being present so the root repo
(ariadne itself, no upstream) is unaffected.

Backport to the ariadne #52 seed template is tracked separately so
future derivatives are seeded with the fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: #4 M2: CI — clone base-layer peers via bootstrap.sh so the runner res…

commits.messageBody:
bootstrap-clone-peers step makes the symlinked runner resolve in
CI; PR #4 run shows both gates passing over the PR range. Mechanism
validated. Remaining: backport the step to the ariadne #52 seed.
